Hi Ethan / Priya —

Thanks again for the discovery earlier — great to hear more about MedNova's use cases for chart summarization and cohort search. Per our call, the next best step is a focused technical session to walk through network/ops prerequisites and our Private (VPC) hosting runbook so your infra team can validate requirements.

Proposed 60-minute windows (all PT):
- Mon Aug 7, 10:00–11:00
- Tue Aug 8, 13:00–14:00
- Wed Aug 9, 08:30–09:30

Agenda (high-level):
- Introductions + roles (5m)
- Private deployment architecture review (20m)
- Network/firewall & routing checklist (15m)
- Ops runbook & day-1 cutover steps (10m)
- Q&A and next steps (10m)

Pre-call asks for your infra/network team:
- Name & contact of the person who owns VPN/firewall rules
- A sample network topology (high-level) — PNG/DIA/Visio OK
- Any specific egress/ingress IP allowlist constraints or proxy requirements

I've attached a short precall checklist and a sample topology image to help guide the discussion. Karthik (Solutions Eng) will cover the deep-dive content; Ben (AE) will join for procurement/SLAs questions.

If none of the proposed slots work, please send two alternatives and we'll prioritize. Once we lock a slot I'll send a calendar invite with dial-in and prep notes.

Thanks,
Sofia

Thanks, Sofia — helpful recap. We're keen to move forward.

Tue Aug 8, 13:00 PT works best for our infra leads (I've looped NetOps). Quick notes from our side:
- We typically use an egress-proxy for outbound connections; will need to confirm if we can allow Redwood's IP ranges or prefer an outbound proxy handshake.
- For on-prem environments we may have an extra NAT layer; will that affect the KV cache/streaming behavior?

I'll surface the topology early next week; NetOps should be able to join the Tue slot. If you can tentatively hold it, we'll confirm formally by EOD Mon.

—Ethan
